title: Student V0.1 Wave 1 — Activity presentation/UI
purpose: Implement accessible learner-safe presentation and response extraction for the frozen v4 activity presentations, including bounded embedded media, without owning correctness or Learning/session semantics.
invariants: UI receives only WAVE1_INTERFACE_FREEZE learner-safe shapes.
UI never receives or derives correctChoiceId, fill answers, acceptedResponses, matching solution, correctOrder or classify assignments.
lesson is readable non-scored exposition and flashcard hides reveal content until learner action.
matching, order and classify are usable without drag-and-drop and must support keyboard/touch interaction.
qcm/fill current visible behavior remains regression-safe.
embedded media is sanitized/fail-closed and no remote URL fetch is added.
No source-manifest or workflow edit occurs before JOB 04 fan-in.
requiredEvidence: Exact common Wave 1 base is proven.
Static secret-boundary tests prove no forbidden scoring fields are rendered or required by UI helpers.
Browser tests exercise lesson, flashcard, matching, order, classify, constructed and qcm/fill regression.
Keyboard and touch-safe alternatives exist for matching/order/classify.
changed paths are a subset of allowedPaths.
adversarialTests: Any UI dependency on correctChoiceId, fill answers, acceptedResponses, matching solution, correctOrder or classify assignments fails the secret-boundary gate.
Matching/order/classify that require drag-and-drop as the only interaction fail accessibility qualification.
Flashcard back content visible before explicit reveal fails qualification.
Unsafe or active SVG/media content must fail closed without network fallback.
Any write outside allowedPaths fails scope.
nonGoals: Owning correctness, scoring or Learning/session progression semantics.
Adding remote media, a plugin system, event bus or evaluator callback framework.
Editing central build, source-manifest or workflow routing before JOB 04.
independentReview: JOB 01 owns Learning semantics independently and must not be modified to accommodate UI shortcuts.
JOB 05 contradictory QA will independently test accessibility and secret isolation after FAN-IN A.
JOB 04 integrates reviewed exact role heads without silently repairing JOB 02 code.
rollback: Drop the JOB 02 commits/branch. No Learning semantics, contracts, persisted learner data or authoring assets are changed.
